Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a categorical exemption under chapter 43.21C RCW for certain electrical facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a categorical exemption for certainelectrical facilities; and adding a new section to chapter 43.21C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following are categorically exempt from the requirements ofthis chapter: (1) The installation, construction, relocation, repair,replacement, maintenance, operation, or alteration of electricfacilities, lines, equipment, or appurtenances, not includingsubstations, with an associated voltage of one hundred fifteen thousandvolts or fewer; (2) Building over existing distribution lines with transmissionlines of one hundred fifteen thousand volts or more; and (3) Placing electric facilities, lines, equipment, or appurtenancesunderground.
